rows: Every body perseveres in a state of rest or uniform motion in a right line unless compelled to change its state by forces impressed thereon
The change of motion is proportional to the motive force impressed (F = ma)
To every action there is always opposed an equal reaction
The force of gravity between two bodies is proportional to their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance
What is the hard core?
Central theoretical commitments protected from falsification by convention; define the program's identity
What is the protective belt?
Auxiliary hypotheses that absorb empirical anomalies; can be revised when failures occur
What is the positive heuristic?
The research agenda: what to investigate next, how to extend the program
What is a progressive research program?
Generates novel predictions that are subsequently confirmed; growing empirical content
What is a degenerating research program?
Makes only ad hoc adjustments; no confirmed novel predictions; shrinking
How does Lakatos respond to Kuhn?
Protective core is rational per negative heuristic; but MSRP adds progressive/degenerating distinction Kuhn lacks
What is Feyerabend's response?
Any methodology can be shown to have been violated by successful science; "anything goes"
